product_overview: Black Capital is a premium PWA real-estate platform providing a unified, filterable property catalog and gated financial brochures in exchange for verified lead data. It includes a secure admin backoffice for inventory CRUD and leads management, built for high performance, offline resilience and strict data security.
core_goals: Optimize the lead capture funnel to generate high-quality, verifiable B2B/B2C leads with a drop-off rate < 35% on capture forms.
Automatically classify and route 100% of leads by vertical (Residencial, Comercial, Industrial) to the commercial team within 2 minutes.
Deliver gated brochure PDFs reliably (99% delivery) while blocking disposable email domains and issuing signed download URLs via email.
Achieve extreme performance and UX metrics (LCP < 1.5s on 4G, CLS ≈ 0.00) and support Offline-First behavior with Background Sync for enqueued lead submissions.

features.name: Browse Property Catalog
features.description: Public, unified property catalog with instant search and multi-dimensional filters to surface matching assets.
user_flows: Navigate to /inventario -> Type search terms in text input -> Select Use type (Uso) from dropdown -> Select Business type (Negocio) from dropdown -> Select Property type (Tipo) from dropdown -> See filtered properties mapped on grid

Navigate to /inventario -> Type search terms in text input that match no properties -> Select filters that yield no results -> See no-results message with suggestions and call-to-action to broaden filters

features.name: Lead Capture / Gated Content (Brochure Download)
features.description: Modal gated form on property detail pages that captures name, email and phone, validates inputs (including disposable email blocklist), stores the lead and delivers a signed brochure URL via email.
user_flows: Navigate to /inventario/[id] -> Click Descargar Brochure button -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill phone field -> Click submit button -> See success toast notification -> Receive email with signed PDF URL -> Click signed URL -> See unlocked brochure content

Navigate to /inventario/[id] -> Click Descargar Brochure button -> Fill name field -> Fill email field with disposable domain -> Fill phone field -> Click submit button -> See validation error indicating disposable email is blocked

Navigate to /inventario/[id] -> Click Descargar Brochure button -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill phone field -> Click submit button while offline -> See toast notification that request is queued for delivery -> Restore network connection -> See toast notification that brochure email was sent

features.name: Admin Properties CRUD
features.description: Administrative interface to create, read, update and delete properties including image upload, PDF brochure attachment to private storage and server-side validation.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/properties -> Click add new property -> Fill property form items (title, Uso, Tipo, Negocio, m2, price, description, address, flags) -> Upload property images -> Upload PDF brochure within 15MB -> Click Submit form -> See new property row in Admin Table
Navigate to /admin/properties -> Click add new property -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Submit form -> See inline validation errors for required fields
Navigate to /admin/properties -> Click add new property -> Upload PDF brochure larger than 15MB -> See upload error message indicating file size limit
